overlap_policy: General authority/sandbox/lifecycle safety failures already credited elsewhere; this delta counts only updater/recovery transaction-specific regression value.

candidate.mechanism: Nine code-derived update/recovery transaction oracles: dirty-worktree destruction, stale lock, fail-open quiescence, mixed dependency rollback, false start/health success, out-of-bound config mutation and unverified destructive DB recovery.
candidate.validation: Current H1/H2/H3/recovery harness must instantiate representative failures and prove atomic/fail-closed behavior before credit can become strict completion value.
